narrative: A woman in grey walks a forest trail at dawn.

panels.title: The Trail
panels.panel_text: A medium shot, eye level, of the woman in grey standing on a packed-dirt forest trail and facing the camera. The woman in grey is a young woman, slender, with long black hair pinned up with jade hairpins, wearing a pale grey kimono. Tall cedar trunks line the trail behind her. The light is overcast and flat, with a muted green and grey palette. The rendering is photorealistic live-action film still.
panels.narration: She has walked this trail before.
panels.motion_prompt: The woman in grey takes two slow steps toward the camera; the camera stays static.

panels.title: The Pause
panels.panel_text: The woman in grey stops and turns her head to the left.
